title: EA FC 25 Ultimate Team
description: Working on one of the biggest live-service games in the world. I analyze player behavior data and help the content team figure out what to release and when.
impact: Data-driven content timing for 10M+ active players

details.challenge: EA FC Ultimate Team needed to maintain player engagement and optimize content releases to keep the community active throughout the season.
details.role: As a member of the analytics team, I contributed to player behavior analysis and helped identify engagement patterns to inform content strategy decisions.
details.approach: Analyzed player data to understand engagement patterns and behavior trends. Collaborated with the team to suggest content timing optimizations based on data insights.
outcomes: Contributed to team efforts in analyzing player engagement metrics
Helped identify key periods for content releases
Participated in cross-functional meetings to share insights
Gained valuable experience in live service analytics
details.learnings: This experience taught me the importance of data-driven decision making in live service games and how player behavior analysis can inform content strategies.

title: JobMap
description: Full-stack job market intelligence platform for bootcamp grads. Aggregates 13K+ listings from 4 APIs, extracts skills with GPT-4o-mini, and generates personalized career reports.
impact: 13K+ jobs indexed, 980 skills mapped, 15 paying users

details.challenge: Bootcamp graduates lack visibility into the real job market — what skills are demanded, which companies are hiring, and how competitive their profile is.
details.role: Co-founder and sole developer. Designed the 68-table database architecture, built the data pipeline, admin dashboard, client app, and landing page.
details.approach: Built a 6-layer canonical database schema to normalize job data from multiple APIs. Automated enrichment with Azure OpenAI for skill extraction, seniority classification, and category assignment. Created an admin dashboard for pipeline monitoring and a client-facing app for job seekers.
outcomes: Aggregated 13,282 job listings from 4 different APIs
Extracted and mapped 980 unique skills with 77,834 job-skill mappings
Onboarded 15 Le Wagon graduates with personalized PDF career reports
Built shard-based pipeline scheduler with 22 shards across 5 schedules
28 automated data quality tests, all passing
details.learnings: Building a data-intensive platform taught me the importance of schema design, data normalization, and pipeline reliability. Running enrichment at scale requires careful cost management and caching.

title: Vote It! Democracy Game

impact: Shipped on 2 platforms, 2K+ downloads, EU Commission recognition

details.challenge: ARDEN needed to create an engaging mobile game that would educate young people about democracy and encourage civic participation, working within budget constraints and timeline requirements.
details.role: Producer and Game Designer, responsible for project coordination, design decisions, team communication, and ensuring the project met its educational and engagement goals.
details.approach: Implemented structured production processes with regular milestones and team check-ins. Co-designed game mechanics that balanced educational content with engaging gameplay. Coordinated between development, art, and content teams.
outcomes: Successfully launched on iOS and Android on schedule
Reached 2,000 downloads in initial release period
Received positive feedback from test groups
Created an educational tool that effectively teaches democratic concepts
Built strong relationships with team members and stakeholders
details.learnings: This project taught me how to balance creative vision with practical constraints, and showed me the potential of games as educational tools for social impact.

title: ORB Trading Bot
description: Automated futures trading system executing Opening Range Breakout strategy on MNQ/MES micro contracts via Interactive Brokers API. Backtested across 8 months of live market data.
impact: 67.7% win rate, +$7,121 backtested profit over 8 months

details.challenge: Manual trading is emotionally driven and inconsistent. Wanted to build a systematic, backtested approach to micro futures that removes emotional decision-making.
details.role: Solo developer. Designed the strategy parameters, implemented the bot, connected to IBKR Gateway, and ran extensive backtests across multiple contracts and sessions.
details.approach: Implemented the Opening Range Breakout strategy with per-contract parameters for entry, stop-loss, take-profit, and breakeven. Connected to Interactive Brokers Gateway for real-time data and order execution. Built a backtesting framework across London and New York sessions.
outcomes: 317 trades backtested: 130 wins, 62 losses, 109 breakeven
67.7% win rate with +$7,121 profit (~$890/month on 1 MNQ)
London session: +$3,309 (64% WR), New York: +$3,812 (71% WR)
Max drawdown limited to -$889 with $500 daily loss cap
Automated execution via systemd with Telegram monitoring alerts
details.learnings: Algorithmic trading taught me the importance of rigorous backtesting, risk management, and the gap between theoretical and live performance. Systems thinking applies to everything.

title: AI Marketing Automation

details.challenge: Repetitive marketing tasks were consuming significant time that could be better spent on creative and strategic work.
details.role: Solo experimenter and workflow designer, exploring various AI tools and creating automation workflows for personal use.
details.approach: Experimented with n8n to create automated workflows, integrated ChatGPT and Gemini APIs for content generation, and tested various automation scenarios to find optimal solutions.
outcomes: Created several working automation workflows for personal use
Reduced time on repetitive tasks by approximately 50%
Gained hands-on experience with AI APIs and automation tools
Developed reusable templates for common marketing tasks
Shared learnings with peers interested in automation
details.learnings: This project taught me the practical applications of AI in everyday tasks and the importance of thoughtful workflow design. Not every task should be automated, but finding the right balance can significantly improve productivity.
